definitions.primary: Paired mean contact difference MARS SHIFT minus Reactive Best-of-3 on fresh cases; bootstrap upper 95% bound < 0 plus no added case-wise return or resource failures.
definitions.compound: Separate identical gate on compound cases. Never pool with fresh single-vortex headline.
definitions.contact: Continuous contact with physical radius + fixed 1 m shared margin, over the same fixed [birth,360] interval. No early return truncation or modeled shelter.
definitions.return: At base within 0.25 m at 360 s with declared reserves; first arrival and final success reported separately.
definitions.stop: Separate acquiring/reaction, arrival, voluntary and an observation-only directional counterfactual avoidable-stop metric.
definitions.latency: Full policy time including its own forecast/path construction and common feasibility gate. Counterfactual stop audit excluded. Separate common-state isolated timing after development; concurrent-run timings are diagnostic only.
definitions.seeds: Fresh synthetic seeds/parameters, reused empirical source references and wind days. Not new independently measured Mars events.
definitions.sand: Published NOAH-H ripple candidates, existing >=25% fraction and >=95% coverage; 5 m conservative footprint buffer and unknown exclusion. Not measured soil strength or trap probability.
definitions.failure: All contact, no-action, return/resource and support failures disclosed; no case removed using outcomes.
definitions.noTuning: No selection, threshold adjustment or case resampling after unblinding. Correctness amendments must preserve failed outputs and disclose a new seal/run.
